lines.2165: 「Why do they travel in packs? Though that's probably why they're brave.」
lines.2166: 「I could defeat them all, but more noise would inconvenience everyone.」
lines.2167: 「Lots of children too. Better not show blood.」
lines.2171: We retreated all the way home.
lines.2172: When the men followed into an empty area, Otome defeated them all.
lines.2173: Returning would cause another commotion, so we'd come home.
lines.2174: 「Those tasteless fools... They got mud on my festival yukata.」
lines.2177: 「I replace mine every year. My parents enjoy it.」
lines.2183: 「We can see them well from here.」
lines.2186: 「It should have been a fun festival, but we had to rush home.」
lines.2187: 「When I see people like that, I cannot help warning them.」
lines.2193: Even I was surprised by the flow.
lines.2196: We'd known our feelings since walking home holding hands.
lines.2197: Even earlier, we'd admitted we might be falling for each other.
lines.2199: We had needed only an opportunity.
lines.2200: A festival and fireworks provided more than enough.
lines.2202: She looked directly into my eyes.
lines.2206: 「I never thought I'd fall for my little-brother figure. You... slay older women.」
lines.2210: I didn't even notice mosquitoes biting me.
lines.2215: The accident with Nishizaki didn't count.
lines.2217: Otome remained lost in the afterglow.
